title: harness-ops team config
description: Schema for a repository's docs/conventions/harness-ops.yaml, the team layer of the harness-ops plugin's settings. The morning_brief keys are resolved by plugins/harness-ops/skills/morning-brief/scripts/morning-brief.sh: a flag beats harness-ops.local.yaml, which beats this file, which beats the default. Contract: docs/conventions/config-cascade/README.md.

org.description: GitHub org whose billing and repos the Cost section reads. Default: the repo's owner.

subscription.description: Azure subscription the Cost section reads. Default: az's current one. Keep it out of a public repository's tracked file; set it in harness-ops.local.yaml.

actions_included_minutes.description: Actions minutes the org's plan includes each month. Unset: the minutes line is INFO with the amount used.

actions_included_storage_gb.description: Artifact storage the plan includes, in GB. Unset: the storage line is INFO with the amount used.

usage_alert_percent.description: Share of an included amount at which a usage line is an ALERT. Default 50.

log_cap_alert_percent.description: Share of a Log Analytics workspace's daily cap at which its peak day is an ALERT. Default 50.

forecast_alert.description: Budget forecast above which an Azure budget is an ALERT. Default: the budget's own amount.

required_budgets.description: Azure budgets that must exist and not end within expiry_days.

anomaly_alert.description: The Cost Management anomaly alert that must exist, be enabled and not end within expiry_days. Default: any anomaly alert.

expiry_days.description: Days before a required budget or the anomaly alert ends at which it is an ALERT. Default 30.

allowed_collaborators.description: Direct repo collaborators, besides org admins, who are not an ALERT.

workflow_read_limit.description: Cap on workflow files read for secret triggers in one run. Default 300.
